name: Medhu Vada with Pondy Chutney
ingredients: For Pondy Chutney: 1/2 cup fresh grated coconut
instructions: 1. Soak urad dal for 2-3 hours and grind into a thick, fluffy batter with minimal water. 2. Fold in green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, crushed pepper, and salt. 3. Wet your palm, take a portion of the batter, flatten it, and make a hole in the center. 4. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy. 5. For the chutney, grind coconut, roasted chana dal, red chili, tamarind, and salt into a smooth paste. 6. Temper with mustard seeds and asafoetida in a little oil and serve hot with the vada.
description: Medhu Vada is a beloved South Indian staple, but in the coastal union territory of Puducherry, it is often paired with a unique, tangy coconut chutney influenced by local Tamil flavors and the subtle use of tamarind, reflecting the region's diverse culinary heritage.
